theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_rc_uniform_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (ε : ℝ) (η : ℝ≥0∞), IsFiniteMeasure μ → Measurable ν → 0 < ε → 0 < η → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall y r) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ ({z | (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z - y‖ ≤ |inner ℝ (z - y) (ν y)|} ∩ closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∃ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), ∃ δ : ℝ, IsCompact K ∧ 0 < δ ∧ μ Kᶜ ≤ η ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ε) * unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ m) ≤ μ (closedBall x ρ)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → μ ({z | (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z - x‖ ≤ |inner ℝ (z - x) (ν x)|} ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ m))
